summary: Logging settings: Logging Aggregator host (an HTTPS URL may include the port; TCP and UDP need the port field), Port, Type, Username, Password/Token, loggers to send (four types by default), cluster-wide unique identifier, Protocol, TCP Connection Timeout (HTTPS and TCP only), Level Threshold and the rsyslog action queue size limit.
questions: What do the AAP logging aggregator fields mean?
Do I need the port field for a TCP log aggregator?
Which loggers can controller send to the aggregator?
What is the cluster wide unique identifier setting?
